output:
All checks pass and only `owns_paths` files changed.

**Changed:**
- `bridge/acp-prompt.mjs` — new module: `promptText(prompt)` joins text blocks and strips `<system_instructions>…</system_instructions>` / `<system-reminder>…</system-reminder>` (multiline, may span blocks), trims.
- `bridge/session.mjs` — `send` accepts `onChatId(chatId)`, invoked the moment the new thread id appears in the page URL.
- `bin/muse-acp.mjs` — imports `promptText`; empty-after-strip prompts answer with the note and never open Chrome; `onChatId` persists `session.museChatId` immediately; a cancelled in-flight send sets `session.pendingReply`, and the next prompt replays the undelivered assistant reply (minus any already-streamed prefix) before sending new text into the same chat; fake driver got per-chat memory, `history`, `onChatId`, and `MUSE_BRIDGE_FAKE_DELAY_MS`.
- `tests/acp-prompt.test.mjs` — stripping cases + the empty-prompt note over ACP.
- `tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs` — cancel mid-reply keeps one chat id and the second turn chunks are `PONG\n\nPONG` (recovered reply first).

```plan-fact
[{"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["bridge/acp-prompt.mjs","cmd:node /tmp/muse-acp-prompt-check/check.mjs"]},{"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["bin/muse-acp.mjs:136-148","bin/muse-acp.mjs:175-201","bin/muse-acp.mjs:211-218","tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs","cmd:node --test tests/acp-prompt.test.mjs tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs"]},{"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:node --test tests/acp.test.mjs tests/session-options.test.mjs"]}]
```

APPROACH: Extracted `promptText` into `bridge/acp-prompt.mjs` stripping the two BB system blocks; `send` reports the new chat id via `onChatId` so `sessions.json` gets `museChatId` before the reply finishes; cancelled sends record `pendingReply` with the streamed prefix, replayed from `history()` on the next prompt of the same session before the new text goes into the same chat.
LESSON: Recording the chat id only after `send` returns loses both the chat and the reply on interrupt — persist transport ids via an early callback, and replay missed replies from history with a delivered-prefix guard.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.

Currently, 'bin/muse-acp.mjs' defines a naive inline 'promptText(prompt)' function that simply joins block text together without removing XML-like tags such as '<system_instructions>' or '<system-reminder>', violating the invariant that only user prompt text reaches Muse. Furthermore, 'bin/muse-acp.mjs' tracks sessions in memory and writes '{ accountId, museChatId }' to 'sessions.json' only after 'driver.send' resolves successfully. If a prompt turn is cancelled mid-flight, 'session.museChatId' is not updated or saved, leading to chat divergence on subsequent prompts.
